dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features multiple high-contrast, irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures. The perimeter geometry is characterized by a jagged, high-intensity white border that transitions abruptly from the dark exterior. The interior of these structures displays a dark-to-light gradient moving from the core back toward the light outer ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density is highest across the mid-dorsal and upper-left lateral regions. Localized clusters of solid high-intensity pixels are concentrated primarily along the leading edges of the macro-annuli, particularly where shapes intersect or overlap.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular, elongated pentagonal relationship across the upper third of the visible pelt, with acute angles formed between the two most superior central nodes and the leftmost lateral node.
